predicted_effect.mechanism: App.cpp has NO source in the tree (find src -iname App.cpp is empty; objects.json declares it and tools/project.py drops the compile edge silently -- the no-source class), so default/App has no base obj and the eight rows become UNPAIRABLE. Today they pair by EH-funclet byte signature against RhythmDetector.obj's own funclets (masked_equal class): fn_822715D8 reads 100/100 (32 B, counted in both measures), the other seven read fuzzy 99.3-99.8 / mpn 99.8 (one charged callee-name site each; counted in neither measure). So the move costs exactly the one 32 B row.
predicted_effect.why_land_it_anyway: Accuracy over headline. Those rows credit RhythmDetector.obj for App::App's cleanups; RhythmDetector's unit denominator is inflated by 312 B of App code, and W16-BA's Item 4 reasoning (which RhythmDetector-body callers the ObjDirPtr dtor has) was contaminated by exactly this mis-carve. It is the same class as b341d7ab's -1/-40 landing.
